defects.title: cli compact appends a newline that pushes output past the budget it was asked to fit
defects.detail: _run_compact writes the string returned by compact.head_tail and then appends '\n' when it does not already end in one. head_tail saturates the budget by construction (its binary search keeps the longest fitting text), so the compacted string is almost always exactly budget tokens; the extra newline makes the printed stream budget + 1. Reproduced with a 6900-char document and --budget 675: head_tail() = 675 tokens, cli stdout = 676 tokens. A fuzz over 300 random (text, budget) pairs overran in 254 of them (~85%). This breaks the advertised pipeline 'tokenbudget compact --budget N | tokenbudget count', which reports N+1.
defects.contract_ref: compact: 'the result must fit the budget as measured by estimate.count_tokens'
defects.suggested_fix: Either emit the compacted text verbatim without the courtesy newline, or reserve count_tokens('\n') from the budget passed to head_tail so the terminated stream still fits.
defects.not_fixed_by_integrator: Single-module behaviour owned by rank 6; recorded rather than rewritten.
defects.test: tests/test_integration.py::test_cli_compact_piped_into_cli_count_stays_within_the_budget (xfail strict=True, flips to a failure once fixed)

defects.title: test suite could not be collected unless pytest was started as 'python -m pytest' from the artifact root
defects.detail: At the time I ran the suite the project had no pyproject.toml/setup.py and no conftest.py, so the artifact root was only on sys.path via the cwd injection that 'python -m pytest' performs. A bare 'pytest -q' failed collection of all 6 unit test files with ModuleNotFoundError: No module named 'tokenbudget'.
defects.fix: I first added a conftest.py at the artifact root to put that directory on sys.path. Rank 0 landed pyproject.toml concurrently with [tool.pytest.ini_options] pythonpath = ['.'], which resolves the same problem properly and also anchors rootdir, so I removed my conftest.py as redundant. Verified after removal: bare 'pytest <artifact>' from an unrelated cwd collects and passes all 87 tests.
defects.test: verified by running /workspace/.venv/bin/pytest -q <artifact> from /tmp, with conftest.py absent
